title: E0057: MD5 or SHA1 used for a password
plain_english: MD5 and SHA1 are fast hash functions. Password hashing should use a deliberately slow, salted algorithm so large-scale guessing attacks are more expensive.
why_matters: If password hashes are exposed, fast unsalted hashes can be cracked much more easily than hashes produced by dedicated password hashing functions.
what_it_checks: Password-like variables or properties used as the hashed value
